og_title: China-linked hackers' AI agents targeted 200-plus organizations, got inside nine | Warning Shots
og_desc: VAPOR PANDA's ARTEX agents hit more than 200 organizations in 11 days from Oct 17; post-exploitation confirmed at nine. No victim named. Severe AI incidents went from 3 to 14 in a year. In 42% of the last 12 months' real-world cases the AI itself did the acting. 166 incidents since 2023, scored 0–100 and sourced. Live tracking of PHP2Shell, 20 dated forecasts, and what officials have said. Updated Oct 30, 10:40 AM ET.
